title: Inventory action supply chain and block new floating refs
objective: Create a zero-dependency repository-wide GitHub Actions uses inventory and a changed-workflow anti-regression gate that blocks newly introduced mutable remote action refs while reporting legacy debt for bounded remediation WUs.
non_goals: rewrite every legacy workflow in one work unit
resolve or update all third-party action versions

forbidden_semantics: secret dependency or SAST scanner changes

required_invariants: inventory parses uses clauses deterministically without executing workflow code
remote actions are immutable only when ref is exactly 40 hexadecimal characters
local ./ actions and docker:// images are classified separately and never mistaken for pinned remote actions
repository-wide legacy floating refs are reported with file line owner repo subpath and ref but WU01 does not silently certify them
changed workflows fail closed if they introduce or retain a remote floating ref in their changed version
new remote refs require later registry verification of repository tag commit and license before legacy remediation can mark them approved
mandatory gate uses no network paid API SaaS LLM or external dependency
acceptance_criteria: full inventory emits deterministic counts of pinned floating local and docker uses
changed-workflow mode returns nonzero for @v4 @main @master branch or semver tag refs
changed-workflow mode accepts full 40-hex remote SHA refs
dynamic or malformed uses expressions fail closed
synthetic tests cover local action docker image SHA tag ref expression and malformed clauses
workflow runs only on .github workflow/action changes plus weekly/manual inventory
legacy debt output is machine-readable and can drive bounded remediation WUs

target_commands: GitHub Actions Security Supply Chain workflow

done_when: repository-wide uses debt is deterministically inventoried
new or changed floating remote action refs are blocked
legacy debt is not hidden and is ready for bounded remediation
inventory/gate remains zero-dependency zero-cost and non-executing
